correctness.rationale: For n>=4 i.i.d. area-uniform points on S², a uniformly selected hull facet has deterministic count normalization 2n-4 and spherical Blaschke–Petkantschin factorization: U=(1+h)/2~Beta(n-1,2) independent of triangle shape, Euclidean facet area A=(1-h²)W. On unit circumcircle interior-angle coordinates x,y, pi-x-y, W=2sin(x)sin(y)sin(x+y), shape density proportional to s=sin x sin y sin(x+y). Independently recomputed full and acute J_p integrals p=1,2,3 by quadrature, matching 3pi/8 and 3pi/16; 3pi²/64 and 3pi²/256+3/16; 35pi/512 and 53pi/1024. Ratios are exactly 1/2, 1/4+4/pi², 53/70, multiplied by beta moments to produce stated all-n total area identities. Boundary triangles right-angled have zero measure; ratios of expectations, not expected realization-wise fractions.
